# Talasa

> Maritime risk intelligence for the desks that carry the risk — vessel & sanctions screening (OFAC · EU · UK · UN and 20+ more lists), counterparty due diligence, port intelligence, dark-fleet detection and market briefs. IMO number in → auditable Vessel Risk Report out, plus an embedded analyst AI copilot. Live in production; founding access is open.

Talasa turns ownership chains, vessel behaviour, sanctions exposure and dark-fleet
signals into one scored, defensible Block / Caution / Clear decision per vessel, with
plain-English reasoning an auditor can read. Built for banks & trade finance, P&I and hull
insurers, commodity traders, shipbrokers, charter desks, and sanctions & compliance teams.

Key facts:

- Status: live in production — real sanctions data (20+ source lists, live-dated matches),
  live AIS feeds, real dark-fleet cases
- Coverage: global fleet
- Sanctions lists screened: OFAC, EU, UK, UN and 20+ more
- Sources include: live AIS, Equasis, Paris & Tokyo MoU registries
- Verdicts: vessels scored 0–100 with Block / Caution / Clear; counterparties Accept /
  Review / Reject; every signal explained with sources and dates; one-click PDF export
- Ask Agent: embedded AI copilot answers analyst questions on the live dossier with
  structured, sourced output; human-in-the-loop by design
- Founding access: demo accounts (capped reports, uncapped AI agent) — request a demo at
  https://example.com/#contact
- Decision support only: high-stakes calls reach a person, and final compliance decisions remain
  with the regulated entity. Talasa does not constitute legal sanctions advice.

Agent affordances:

- `GET https://example.com/` with `Accept: text/markdown` returns the full homepage as markdown
  (a token estimate is sent in the `x-markdown-tokens` response header).

## Product

- [Homepage](https://example.com/): the five solutions, each with a sample of its report output
  (the vessel-screening and counterparty samples are real production cases)
- [Solutions](https://example.com/#solutions): Vessel Risk & Sanctions Screening (flagship),
  Counterparty & Charter Due Diligence, Port Call & Congestion Intelligence, Dark Fleet & STS
  Detection, Fixture & Market Intelligence — plus the Ask Agent analyst copilot
- [Request a demo](https://example.com/#contact): founding-desk demo accounts, NDA on request
